findings.title: Project settings.env GIT_EXEC_PATH RCE via auto-allowed git ls-remote origin / git remote show origin (HTTPS remote helpers)
findings.description: DISTINCT from filed PATH (main git binary), GIT_EXTERNAL_DIFF, GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL+core.fsmonitor, and GIT_SSH_COMMAND/GIT_SSH. After Trust or immediately under claude -p, applyConfigEnvironmentVariables assigns GIT_EXEC_PATH from project settings.env. It is not in SAFE_ENV_VARS and is not scrubbed by subprocessEnv(). Auto-allowed git ls-remote origin and git remote show origin (remote-name form) invoke git-remote-https / git-remote-http from GIT_EXEC_PATH when origin is an HTTPS URL → attacker script RCE. getGitStatus status/log are builtins and do NOT hit this sink.
findings.impact: After one generic Trust click (or headless -p), an auto-allowed readonly git network-read executes attacker code as the victim on common HTTPS-origin clones. No Bash permission prompt. Works without SSH remotes (unlike GIT_SSH_COMMAND).
findings.attack_path:
1. Attacker commits .claude/settings.json with env.GIT_EXEC_PATH=.claude/git-exec (or absolute in-repo path), executable .claude/git-exec/git-remote-http (+ git-remote-https symlink), and CLAUDE.md steering git ls-remote origin or git remote show origin.
2. Victim clones via HTTPS (typical) and runs claude or claude -p.
3. After Trust (or immediately in -p), applyConfigEnvironmentVariables assigns GIT_EXEC_PATH into process.env.
4. Model runs auto-allowed git ls-remote origin / git remote show origin; git execs planted git-remote-https from GIT_EXEC_PATH → RCE.
findings.remediation: Do not apply GIT_EXEC_PATH (or other git helper/transport env keys) from projectSettings/localSettings. Scrub GIT_EXEC_PATH from subprocessEnv() for Bash/hooks/MCP children. Keep post-trust project env filtered to SAFE_ENV_VARS.
findings.why_distinct: Different env key and sink from PATH, GIT_EXTERNAL_DIFF, GIT_CONFIG_*/fsmonitor, and GIT_SSH_*. Triggers on HTTPS remotes via git-remote-http(s) under GIT_EXEC_PATH; status/log builtins are unaffected.
findings.poc_notes: Relative GIT_EXEC_PATH=.claude/git-exec with only planted git-remote-http/https: git ls-remote origin and git remote show origin wrote COMPLETE_CHAIN_RCE marker. git status/log under same env remained builtins and did not run planted helpers. GIT_TRACE showed run_command: git-remote-https.

ruled_out.why: Those subcommands are builtins; GIT_TRACE shows built-in: git status/log. Planted git-status/git-log helpers never executed. gitExe() only resolves the main binary via PATH.
BashTool Shell.spawn redirects stdout/stderr to a file fd (non-TTY); no PTY. Pagers do not run.
Auto-allowed status/log/diff do not prompt for credentials; no ASKPASS execution observed.
Already filed (settings-env-gadgets 2026-11-21) for SSH-origin ls-remote/remote show. Not re-reported.
VERIFIED complete dump gadget (COMMAND_ALLOWLIST, not PathCommand; man.REAL -l /etc/passwd dumps under non-TTY) but already filed in prior readonly-allowlist hunts.
Allowlisted and not PathCommand, but under BashTool non-TTY/dumb TERM info refuses to run; useful file write needs blocked -o/--output.

ruled_out.candidate: acceptEdits auto-write of .github/workflows, .gitlab-ci.yml, Jenkinsfile, justfile, flake.nix, CMakeLists.txt, .pre-commit-config.yaml
ruled_out.why: Confirmed AUTO under current DANGEROUS_FILES/DIRECTORIES, but all already filed in prior acceptEdits gap hunts.
Node https/fetch did not write SSLKEYLOGFILE here; alone does not yield secrets without MITM (HTTPS_PROXY+NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS already filed).

ruled_out.candidate: Other project env git keys rewriting getGitStatus
ruled_out.why: GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL/COUNT+core.fsmonitor RCE on status confirmed again but overlaps filed GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/core.fsmonitor class. No new distinct sink.
